resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's 1953 date is the current tower. It replaced a crow's nest platform dated to the 1920s by the register and to about 1930 by firelookout.com and Montana Lookouts.

notes_for_editor: Staffing conflicts: the register's October 2012 visit report says staffed sometimes and used in emergencies; the undated Chronicle feature says regularly manned; the smokejumper article (undated, refers to 2012 as past) says staffed in high fire danger. Story reports all three; facts.staffing uses the 2012 register statement. Height: 41 ft (register, firelookout.com) vs 40 ft (Chronicle, Montana Lookouts); height_m 12.5 is 41 ft converted. Elevation: record 2094.6 m matches the register's 6,872 ft; firelookout.com and the Chronicle give 7,077 ft. Record left unchanged. The register's description calls it Horse Mountain Lookout in one sentence, a name slip. Current access and climbability not verified on site. No photos added.
